entities.name: Napoleonic Wars
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Series of wars (1803–1815) fought between Napoleonic France and shifting coalitions of European powers. The wars reshaped the European map, spread revolutionary ideas, stimulated nationalism, and ended with Napoleon's defeat at Waterloo.
